/* tuiflow styles — the `.tf` block every tuiflow panel renders into.
 * Keep every glyph in ONE monospace font that covers box drawing (U+2500–257F)
 * and block elements (U+2580–259F); mixed fonts break the grid. */
.tf {
  font-family: "JetBrains Mono", "Cascadia Mono", "Fira Code", "DejaVu Sans Mono", Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.25;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  white-space: pre;
  /* Inherit the Grafana theme so ?theme=matrix turns the whole box green;
     only semantic accents below get fixed colours. */
  color: inherit;
  background: transparent;
}
/* Accent colours are CSS variables so a host can map them to its theme (the
   panel plugin sets --tf-* from Grafana's theme); the fallbacks are the
   video palette from docs/look-spec.md, used wherever a host sets none. */
.tf .tf-edge { color: var(--tf-edge, #e8a06a); font-weight: 700; }
.tf a.tf-link { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
.tf .tf-dim { opacity: 0.55; }
.tf .tf-axis { opacity: 0.45; }
.tf .tf-value { font-weight: 700; }
.tf .tf-ok { color: var(--tf-ok, #86d28a); }
.tf .tf-warn { color: var(--tf-warn, #e8a06a); }
.tf .tf-crit { color: var(--tf-crit, #e06c75); }
.tf .tf-border { opacity: 0.6; }
.tf .tf-up { color: var(--tf-ok, #86d28a); }
.tf .tf-down { color: var(--tf-crit, #e06c75); }
/* heatmap density levels */
.tf .tf-h1 { color: var(--tf-h1, #4b5563); }
.tf .tf-h2 { color: var(--tf-s1, #8fb3ff); }
.tf .tf-h3 { color: var(--tf-s0, #e8a06a); }
.tf .tf-h4 { color: var(--tf-h4, #ffd27a); }
/* series colours for tfTimeseries / tfStat (cycle of 6) */
.tf .tf-s0 { color: var(--tf-s0, #e8a06a); }
.tf .tf-s1 { color: var(--tf-s1, #8fb3ff); }
.tf .tf-s2 { color: var(--tf-s2, #86d28a); }
.tf .tf-s3 { color: var(--tf-s3, #c792ea); }
.tf .tf-s4 { color: var(--tf-s4, #e06c75); }
.tf .tf-s5 { color: var(--tf-s5, #9aa0a6); }
/* same palette as background, for half-block pixels (tfPie: ▀ = fg over bg) */
.tf .tf-bg0 { background: var(--tf-s0, #e8a06a); }
.tf .tf-bg1 { background: var(--tf-s1, #8fb3ff); }
.tf .tf-bg2 { background: var(--tf-s2, #86d28a); }
.tf .tf-bg3 { background: var(--tf-s3, #c792ea); }
.tf .tf-bg4 { background: var(--tf-s4, #e06c75); }
.tf .tf-bg5 { background: var(--tf-s5, #9aa0a6); }

/* flame scan, geomap ping, CRT cursor */
.tf .tf-scan { color: var(--tf-h4, #ffd27a); }
.tf .tf-ping { animation: tf-ping 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
.tf .tf-cursor { animation: tf-blink 1s step-end infinite; color: var(--tf-ok, #86d28a); }
@keyframes tf-ping {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
  50% { opacity: 0.25; }
}
@keyframes tf-blink {
  50% { opacity: 0; }
}

/* Opt-in "video palette" regardless of Grafana theme: class="tf tf-video" */
.tf-video { color: #c9ced6; background: #0f1218; }
